newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-MOOBLIMAJA TO DECIDE ON PROFIT DISTRIBUTION.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-MOOBLIMAJA TO DECIDE ON PROFIT DISTRIBUTION.

text.p: The shareholders of Mooblimaja (Furniture House), whose shares are traded on the OTC market, will on June 20 decide on its profit distribution, it said on Tuesday.
The board will propose the distribution of last year's 64,000 kroons and on the retained profit of three million kroons, Uno Kallas, chairman, told Reuters.
Kallas said the profit in 1996 was small due to large investments. The company has invested 14.5 million kroons since it was privatised in 1995.
Mooblimaja's first quarter net profit in 1997 was over one million kroons and it estimates that its net profit will be over four million kroons for the whole of 1997, Kallas added.
Kallas said Mooblimaja will definitely list its shares on the stock exchange but after it has fulfilled its obligations to the privatisation agency by September 1 next year.
The majority of its 3.5 million kroons share capital is held by M-Investments Group and the rest or 49 percent by small investors.
Mooblimaja is one of the largest furniture sellers in Estonia.
